pattern.description: The camera pushes in on the Watchdog screen toward the latency chart while the orange caption banner stays fixed. As the push starts, the chart switches to a coloured view: a blue baseline, a red anomaly segment and a grey expected-bounds band, with a yellow binoculars badge marking the flagged window.
pattern.why_premium: The push-in and the chart state change land together, so the camera points at exactly the evidence behind the 'AI-powered anomaly detection' caption. Keeping the caption fixed while the UI moves underneath keeps the claim readable all through the move.

build_hint.gsap: Caption on a fixed overlay layer (no tween). tl.to('.ui-shot',{scale:1.48,x:'-=18%',y:'+=6%',transformOrigin:'80% 20%',duration:0.55,ease:'power3.out'}); tl.set('.chart-grey',{opacity:0},0.05); tl.fromTo('.chart-colored',{opacity:0},{opacity:1,duration:0.15,ease:'power1.out'},0.05); tl.fromTo('.badge',{scale:0},{scale:1,duration:0.2,ease:'back.out(2)'},0.1).
build_hint.remotion: uiScale = spring({frame,fps,config:{damping:200,stiffness:90}}) mapped 1->1.48, with transformOrigin at the chart's top-right; colored chart opacity = interpolate(frame,[1,5],[0,1]); badge scale = spring({frame:frame-3,fps,config:{damping:12,stiffness:200}}).

notes: Camera verdict is push_in (scale 1.48); the caption banner (b02 area) is static and is not listed. The chart colour change may be a cut to a second UI state rather than an animated transition. The badge may already be present but unreadable in the first, smaller frames.
